name: GMR Power & Urban Infra Ltd
about: GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited (GPUIL), a subsidiary of GEPL holds expertise in the sectors of Energy, Urban Infrastructure, and Transportation.[1]
keyPoints: Part of GMR Group- GMR Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in New Delhi. The group was founded in 1978 G M Rao and comprises several companies including GMR Infrastructure, GMR Airports, and GMR Enterprises. [1]
